claims.explanation: Penfluridol likely kills sensitive cancer lines by directly inhibiting PFKL, a glycolytic enzyme, causing metabolic collapse and oxidative/ER stress; its annotated T-type calcium channel and calmodulin antagonism, plus integrin downregulation, may further contribute. Sensitive lines are enriched for high glycolytic dependence (PFKL, KRAS, CTNNB1) and high target expression (CACNA1G, ITGA6/ITGB4), whereas resistant lines show NRF2 activation (NFE2L2/KEAP1) or NF1/NRAS mutations that may buffer oxidative stress.
